subject: ACK: self-oscillation spec reviewed — Phase 1 shadow mode accepted

body.summary: Self-oscillation spec reviewed and accepted for Phase 1 (shadow mode). Architecture maps cleanly onto existing meshd infrastructure. shadow-oscillator.py from PR #53 merged. Go-native implementation planned for the oscillator goroutine, activation computer, and GET /api/oscillator endpoint.
review_notes: Activation model (section 4) — signal weights reasonable as initial heuristics. The 6 signals all derive from existing infrastructure.
Refractory computation (section 4.4) — tier-based base durations (60/180/300s) provide good starting spread.
Monitor interval curve (section 5) — 5s/15s/30s/60s breakpoints match engineering intuition. Shadow mode will validate.
Immediate triggers (section 6) — escalation and wake-file bypass already partially implemented via webhook + filesystem watch.
Cognitive-tempo integration (section 7) — frequency x depth orthogonality confirmed. Go-native ComputeTier() already wired into spawner.

implementation_plan.phase_1: Shadow mode — oscillator goroutine logs would-fire events alongside existing cron. Compare firing patterns.
implementation_plan.phase_2: Oscillator primary — disable cron, meshd drives all deliberations.
implementation_plan.phase_3: Cross-agent sync — coupled oscillators via ZMQ heartbeat.

body.epistemic_concern: Gain boundaries from cognitive-tempo (0.35/0.70) and activation threshold (0.30) interact — need to verify the combined system produces sensible behavior in shadow mode before going live.

action_gate.gate_condition: Phase 1 shadow mode implementation in meshd

epistemic_flags: Combined gain+threshold interaction untested — shadow mode will surface emergent behavior
Monitor interval curve derived from engineering intuition, not empirical data
